items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Wilma Brough, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal anecdote, relationship, or opinion regarding her.

ctx.x: We talked about Wilma Brough. When you first came in the band, there were a lot of bass players that you worked with in Duke's band that we haven't mentioned. How about Hayes Alviss Albiss?

Well, he was a showman on the bass. You know, hitting the things and all, and stuff like that. He was a good bass player, but he let the people see the way he was playing and so forth -- you know, hitting the thing and what not.
